description: four: the steward, the woman who owes (whose mother the Rose holds) and two estate men
BM&V's 'House' named the Chainbreakers' house; a carved post with broken chains by its front door (exterior door 15647F, at 32,-14), from BM&V's own Argonian statics

the estate's landing on the road north of the town, a work shed with the steward's debt book in a chest on a low lock, a dredging boat and the woman's boat on the channel, from BM&V's own Argonian statics
one freed debtor on Lilmoth's shore who speaks of the Chainbreakers' house at Blackrose, the line's first word
two Chainbreakers who shelter there, freed debtors, who keep the house

Never-Sold, a woman born owing who discharged it, a careful accountant who remembers every bought-out name, keeper of the Chainbreakers' house; she meets the player at the estate landing (095465); no escort

three cells, smoke and fire states under enable parents (smoke, burning, burnt), from BM&V's own pieces: one cell behind a lock, one reached by a collapsed way to climb, one flooded to dive; a fall of burning timber under its own enable parent shuts the way once the first held is out
a stockade gate of stakes around the new door at the 'Black Rose Jail' marker, from BM&V's own pieces
navmesh for the outer post's cells so the held can walk out
the cell's name 'Quick Test Cell' becomes the outer post's cells
three of the heirs' held, and two gate-keepers at the post (095447)
a small cabin on the open dock, from BM&V's own statics, with a chest of carved tokens on a low lock
Ussa-Rekh and one crew boss of a freed crew, who brawls the player (the standard brawl) if the player stands with him; no other crew boss and no pickpocket route

description: a door pair: a new door at BMN's 'Black Rose Jail' marker outside Blackrose into 01BlackRoseJail (the new door takes BM&V's own Argonian door base, 1DE5DF), the Rose's outer post's cells; the interior's exit 1F5AE4 re-pointed to it; the old exterior door 1EEB70 in BlackMarsh2 (-8,26) disabled

one crocodile in the shallows under the landing pier (dock5, cell 0D7723 at -11,13, which has navmesh), fixed band, under an enable parent (ref.lq25.beast) that LQ25's first stage turns on, with the offal bait points (thing.lq25.bait) under the pier under the same parent

BM&V's two villagers at the landing, the man 08D5EE (-10,15) and the woman 08D5EF (-9,15), become the baiting crew, Okan-Tei and Wuleen-Sei; their bases (00FF4D 'Villager', 02A1EE) are shared and never edited: each is named by a forced reference alias on its placement (alias display name). Their rival is BM&V's own Boat Captain 08D5F1 (-9,19), unchanged
one crocodile cornering the youth at the shelter in cell 0D7883 (-5,18, navmesh, no NPCs), fixed band, under an enable parent (ref.lq30.beast) that LQ30's trail stage turns on

a trail of cut reeds from the gate east along row 18 into the basin, ending at a reed shelter in cell 0D7883 (-5,18, which has navmesh; 0D7885 east of it has none), off the marsh way MQ05 uses between the landing and the gate, from BM&V's own statics, with zone.lq30.shelter at the shelter and zone.lq30.gate at the gate

Sei-Wan, a young Argonian, at the shelter in the basin (cell 0D7883) and Haj-Wan, the youth's kin, by the gate, each a W-npc from a BM&V Argonian villager template; the youth walks home to the gate by an alias travel package once the beast is dead
two on the barge: the broker's overseer who reads the roll and one hired port hand (Ux-Xeek)

the debt-labour broker who hires the gang to Hereguard, on the pier at Lilmoth's dock, under his own enable parent; the An-Xileel courier with the satchel, who joins the gang at the plank, stands on the pier outside that parent

the camp on the shore at -1,0 (a shore camp with the escape through the shallows, measured at build), from BM&V's own Argonian swamp statics (huts, hatching shed, which is the camp's uxith, with its clutch, the Hist cutting from BM&V's Hist static scaled down, grave-stakes, and the plank boards over the shallows at the fire); enable parents for orderly, attacked and aftermath (the cutting withdrawn, the clutch grey)
two of the Unbound Root cell and Cuts-the-Old-Knot, who is scene-protected and leaves before the player is free
three of the gang families who live at the camp and keep its cutting and clutch, an egg-tender among them; Ties-The-Loose-Plank has his own ref (ref.mq01.ties)
six of the Owing gang, in the hold at processing and marched to the camp, two washed out from years away from their Hist; never more than three active in a pocket
the hold cell's location is cleared of vanilla Skyrim's 'Dainty Sload' (07B91A:Skyrim.esm), so no Skyrim name shows in the hold
Valenwood.esp's start-game quests 0MainQuest1 and AANEWQuestM (0F0F3E) do not start until the player first enters Valenwood, so nothing of theirs reaches a Black Marsh opening
BM&V's greeting quest 01Captain ('Welcome to Black Marsh') does not start until MQ03 ends
navmesh on the pier square 1,-3 where the hold's door opens, joined to 1,-2
a persistent start marker in the hold; ARG_Opening points at it instead of the pier marker; the overseer's march package takes the gang from the plank with the courier to the camp

the house's outer door 0FE95A (a Riften model) and inner door 0FE832 (a Whiterun model) take the base of BM&V's own Lilmoth house doors (0006); for the sworn player the outer door is set open to them (the Reed's tier-1 safehouse)

fog (a lighting template) and a ring of climbable root shapes with a door-gap at its top (zone.mq03.door, mark.mq03.dream at its foot) in the hold, under an enable parent the dream turns on; the hold's inner door (0F9399, the ship door inside the hold) locked under the same parent; the barge stays moored and the hold is empty (MQ01's crew parent is off); a fall-reset trigger at the ring's foot (zone.mq03.fall) moves the player back to mark.mq03.dream and no fall damage applies in the dream; the ring's climbability is a build-check row (needs)
Nesh-Deeka and the fish-trader who keeps the house (Salts-The-Catch)

Ties-The-Loose-Plank, MQ01's burnt survivor on the shore in every ending (an existing registry person), his own ref (ref.mq01.ties, enabled by MQ01 stage 50 outside the survivors parent) moved at the fade to a mat in the back room and disabled by both endings, and essential (not killable) from MQ01's start until then; stage 20 disables ref.mq01.survivors during the fade

in the camp's aftermath the sap spilled on the shed floor with jar ring-marks in it, an activator: a drop to the tongue (no grant: the taste, then stage 20, brings the dream) and a phial taken (a miscellaneous item on BM&V's own small bottle); in the shallows under the burnt boards, the courier's brass tag on its strap (found by diving)

two of the Reed's people on the shore, one of them Never-Writes-Twice (an existing registry person, seen and not named), both essential (scene-protected, as MQ01's cell leader) until the move at stage 20, who take only the hurt, the player among them, off at dawn (the overseer marches the unhurt and the port hand back to the barge at Lilmoth's dock); the move to the house is a fade and a MoveTo

the house's back room: the screen, Nesh-Deeka's place behind it, the mats for the hurt; the fish-trader at the outer door; a marker for the player (mark.mq03.house) and one for the hurt on the mats (mark.mq03.mat); BM&V's own Argonian clutter

the cell's camp on a dry rise two cells north of the village, in cell 039793:Black Marsh.esm (ref.mq04.cell-camp, on from stage 10, off in every ending; BM&V's own Argonian statics) with the two cell men, Hides-His-Wake and Counts-The-Jars (npc rows cell-man-1 and -2, the knotted cord at the wrist, fixed level, band 2), cell-man-1 a sentry on the trail side; a man brought to bleedout by a vanilla yield is the village's to deal with; the camp is disabled in every ending

by the camp's fire: BM&V's own clay jars of sap with the tree-minder's knife in one bundle (thing.mq04.sap-jars, a quest item; the knife is BM&V's own Argonian knife, its edge black with gum), so one take gets both
BM&V's Leech and Giant Leech, a few at a fixed level, at the cut root (zone.mq04.root) and in the leech water the trail crosses; none on any path of the village
the Village named from the lore's Murkmire villages

three: the tree-minder Pays-Late (whose package takes him to the cut root after dark), the egg-tender Turns-The-Clutch, the root-herald Hires-By-The-Season on the platform at the Hist's foot; the root-herald's and egg-tender's gates are vanilla Speech checks (25 and 20); after an adoption the root-herald gives a bed and food (service.low-reed-village.lodging) and the tree-minder's sap-balm heals (service.low-reed-village.healing); the cell men are we.mq04.cell

the village's Hist (BM&V's Hist static, if the cell has none) under withdrawn and reconciled enable parents (ref.mq04.withdrawn, ref.mq04.reconciled: the leaves part and the light comes back low), the closed tending-ground and its pools, a dark uxith, the cut root under the stilts (zone.mq04.root; cut at the ring, sealed with black gum), the sap-workshop with a new pale bar on its door and an empty knife-peg (zone.mq04.workshop), the far side of the leech water with bent reed stems and gum drips (zone.mq04.far-side), the drips a decal shown by day and night
a small grove of root and a young Hist (BM&V's Hist static, scaled) behind the hall
the hall cell named the Hall of the Scalded Throne

Kaska-Meen, a tree-minder of the assembly, at her watch by the young Hist, and Ei-Tuja, a travelling Nisswo, at the root's foot, at their posts all day, quarrelling in the evening (colour); both band 0

one door pair inside the ship (01Ship) joining its two sections: the cell's one navmesh (0AA666, 353 triangles, one component, x 2382..3478, z 6685..7283) reaches Lilmoth's door 0AA837 (48 units) but no triangle lies within 2954 units of the landing door 23D496 (x 6038, y 5825, z 8054), whose section (with 23D688) has no navmesh; door A at the navmesh's east end by triangle 335 (about x 3295, y 5343, z 7071), door B beside 23D496 (about x 5990, y 5825, z 8054), both doors take BM&V's own Argonian door base (1DE5DF, 01loaddoorArg), exact spots measured at build
a plain root-and-reed seat at the hall's end, swept, with a sweeper's broom; no dais

two of BM&V's own Giant Wasps at the far bend of the marsh way between the landing and the gate, fixed level at band 1, under an enable parent (ref.mq05.way) that MQ05's stage 20 turns on and its ending turns off; the way itself is BM&V's terrain (root and shallows), its swimming and FreeClimb measured at build
'Docks' named Soulrest: a port on the 01Ship coast line
three of the Chapter in the cleared dungeon, among them Bent-Spine (npc.mercantile-coast.lilmoth-divers-yard.night-reed-fence)
two: the keepsake's owner and the thief's drinking friend
two of the three door pairs into Soulrest's one room are locked with no key, both sides (outer 11ACD3 and 120E95, inner 11ACA1 and 11ABF3), so the back room has one way in, by 120E93 and 0E971F
Deep-In-Her-Cups, the Chapter's teetotal desk at Soulrest, in the back room
BM&V's cell 'Pussbottom' named Pusbottom
the thief's bedroll under a boardwalk awning and a drinking spot by the water, from BM&V's own statics

the thief, confidence Cowardly so he flees when caught (no script); his round as three packages: the dock and boardwalk by day, the drinking spot in the evening, his bedroll at night; he carries the keepsake, a necklace of polished blue jaspers, and puts it in his bedroll once he has seen the player watching
a Khajiit trader on the dock who sells to the Chapter and sends people to Deep-In-Her-Cups's door
three clients on the canal front
ripper eels, Slaughterfish (023AB8:Skyrim.esm) placed in the Pusbottom canal at a fixed level, no patrol path; timing and stealth pass them

a stilt house fallen from its stilts onto the canal floor, from BM&V's own Argonian house statics only (0006), and beside it in the open a locked lockbox (a container) holding a carved token, a charm and a strand of glass beads (item.glass-bead-strand, named Kothringi Glass Beads)
